name: Saved artist layouts restore panel placement and unchanged artwork
description: After drawing a recognizable mark, changing panel placement and saving a named layout must restore that layout and the same saved artwork after reload.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local PixiBun Studio at a 1440 by 900 desktop viewport.
Draw a recognizable diagonal mark with Pen on the blank canvas.
Pan the drawing view using the navigator overview.
Fit the canvas using the navigator control.
Move the inspector to the left.
Save the current layout under the name Animation desk.
Press Shift+Tab with the drawing canvas focused to restore panels.
Verify the Workspace list selects Animation desk, the inspector is left of the canvas, and navigator and timeline are visible in their usable layout.
Verify the saved diagonal artwork is unchanged after navigation, canvas-only mode and reload.
